patient.name: 佐仓濑津美
patient.diagnosis: 盆壁局限性复杂病灶紧邻髂血管、输尿管与盆壁神经，需要完整切除并重建受累的髂血管。
patient.diagnosis_en: A complex localized pelvic sidewall lesion lies close to the iliac vessels, ureter and pelvic nerves, requiring resection and reconstruction of the affected iliac vessel.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……我不太会和第一次见面的医生说话。」
lines.text_en: “...I am not very good at talking to a doctor I have just met.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「没关系。你可以慢慢说，我先把检查结果告诉你。」
lines.text_en: “That is all right. Take your time. I will start by explaining the results.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「他们说，病灶靠近很多重要的地方。」
lines.text_en: “They told me the lesion is close to a lot of important things.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「是。我们需要沿盆壁切除它，还要处理附近的髂血管。神经和输尿管也必须仔细辨认。」
lines.text_en: “Yes. We need to remove it along the pelvic sidewall and reconstruct part of the nearby iliac vessel. We also need to identify the nerves and ureter carefully.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「听起来不像会很快结束。」
lines.text_en: “That does not sound like a quick operation.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「是台大手术。所以我会安排熟悉这些步骤的助手，大家分工完成。」
lines.text_en: “It is a major operation. I will assign assistants who know these steps well, and we will work as a team.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……以前我常常只看着病房的窗户。看久了，就觉得外面的路和自己没什么关系。」
lines.text_en: “...I used to spend a lot of time looking out of a hospital window. After a while, the roads outside stopped feeling like they had anything to do with me.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「那就先把这台手术做好。以后去哪儿，你再自己决定。」
lines.text_en: “Then let us get through this operation. After that, you can decide where to go.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「你说得很轻松。」
lines.text_en: “You make it sound easy.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我知道并不轻松。」
lines.text_en: “I know it is not easy.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……好。我把这次机会交给你们。」
lines.text_en: “...All right. I will put this chance in your hands.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……手术，已经结束了吗？」
lines.text_en: “...Is the operation over?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「结束了。接下来需要观察血管重建区和你的恢复情况。」
lines.text_en: “It is over. We still need to monitor the reconstructed vessel and your recovery.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我总以为，醒来以后还是只能继续等。」
lines.text_en: “I always thought I would wake up and have nothing to do but wait again.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「这回有别的事可以想了。比如出院后去哪儿。」
lines.text_en: “This time you have something else to think about. Such as where to go after discharge.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……可以先从病房门口开始吗？」
lines.text_en: “...Could I start with the hospital room door?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「当然。等恢复允许，我们从那儿开始。」
lines.text_en: “Of course. We can start there when you are ready.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「真奇怪。以前连想都不愿意想的事，现在反而有点期待。」
lines.text_en: “It feels strange. Now I am looking forward to things I used to refuse even to think about.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……谢谢你，坂口医生。」
lines.text_en: “...Thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「别只谢我。或许也该谢谢星见医院那点不可思议的魔法。」
lines.text_en: “Do not thank only me. Perhaps you should also thank a little of Hoshimi Hospital's peculiar magic.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……那种事，我还不能确定。」
lines.text_en: “...I am not sure about that.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「不过，今天的窗外，看起来确实不太一样。」
lines.text_en: “But the view outside the window really does look different today.”
